title: Additional Russian Detective Required By S.2

page_data.en:

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SOV REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. D. REGN. Station,
No. S. B. D. 8/16
Date February 19, 1931.
at 19 - 2 - 31.

Subject (in full) Application for additional Russian detective to
Special Branch No. 2.

Made by / and Forwarded by D.S.I. Duncan.

Sir,

I respectfully wish to bring to your notice
that the recent opening in Shanghai of Soviet establishments
has resulted in an influx of Soviet citizens and agents,
and also that evidence has been coming to light that Shanghai
is being made a base for world wide dissemination of red
propaganda.

The new situation thus created involves more work
for S. 2, and in order to be able to discharge this work
efficiently I respectfully submit that a 3rd Russian detective
is required. The necessity for a 3rd Russian is intensified
by reason of the fact that the two men now available, while
intelligent and energetic, lack experience and connections
consequently enquiries take longer to complete.

W. Duncan.
D. S. I.

D. C. (C. & S. Branches)

For favour of consideration.
M
19.2.31.

cc. (SB)
Sg
M. Duncan says a man
would not be necessary if
the Boarding House Section could
help them as formerly. This has been arranged with Supt. Kojitzky
Yorke
19.2

表格第2号

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
苏维埃事务报告

档案编号。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记站，
南分局第8/16号
日期：1931年2月19日。
于1931年2月19日。

主题（全称）：申请为特别股第二组增派一名俄籍侦探。

由邓肯（Duncan）警司提出并转呈。

阁下：

谨提请阁下注意，近期苏联机构在上海的设立，导致苏联公民及特工大量涌入；此外，有证据显示，上海正被用作向全球散布红色宣传的基地。

由此产生的新形势增加了特别股第二组的工作量。为能有效履行此项职责，谨建议需增派第三名俄籍侦探。鉴于目前仅有的两名人员虽聪慧勤勉，但缺乏经验与人脉关系，致使调查工作耗时较长，故对第三名俄籍人员的需求更为迫切。

W. 邓肯。
警司。

副总监（刑事与特别股）

供审议。
M
1931年2月19日。

抄送：（特别股）
Sg
邓肯先生称，若寄宿管理处能如以往那般提供协助，则无需增派人员。此事已与科吉茨基（Kojitzky）巡官商定。
约克（Yorke）
2月19日
LCA
备注。
2月18日 3月30日
